description: Handle missing RIOT_API_KEY (status 500) with user-friendly message. Currently when RIOT_API_KEY is not set, riotFetch() throws RiotApiError('RIOT_API_KEY is not configured', 500). This falls through to the generic RiotApiError handler in route.ts and returns the internal error message to users. The fix expands the catch condition to also return the 503 'Service temporarily unavailable' response when the key is missing.
steps: In app/api/riot/route.ts, modify the catch block's condition from `if (error.status === 401 || error.status === 403)` to also cover the case where RIOT_API_KEY is not configured. The riotFetch() function throws RiotApiError('RIOT_API_KEY is not configured', 500) - so also match when error.message contains 'RIOT_API_KEY is not configured' or check for status 500 with that specific message. The goal is to return the same user-friendly 503 'Service temporarily unavailable, please try again later' response.

Create a unique branch named 'fix/handle-missing-api-key-503-v2' (use v2 suffix to avoid conflicts with existing PRs). Commit the change with message 'fix: return 503 for missing RIOT_API_KEY instead of leaking internal error'.
Run npm run build to verify the change compiles successfully.
Run npm run lint to verify no lint errors.
acceptance_criteria: When RIOT_API_KEY is not set, the API route returns status 503 with body {error: 'Service temporarily unavailable, please try again later', status: 503}
When RIOT_API_KEY is expired (401/403 from Riot), the existing behavior is preserved (same 503 response)
npm run build passes with zero errors
npm run lint passes with zero errors
verification: Run `npm run build` in the project root and confirm it succeeds
Run `npm run lint` and confirm no errors
